objetivo: Identificar los principales tipos de buques mercantes y la carga que transporta cada uno.

parrafos: Every day, thousands of {{merchant ships}} carry goods around the world. More than 80 percent of world trade by volume travels by sea. Ships move oil, grain, cars, clothes and machines from one {{port}} to another.

There are different ships for different kinds of {{cargo}}. A {{container ship}} carries steel boxes called containers. A {{bulk carrier}} carries loose cargo such as grain, coal or iron ore. A {{tanker}} carries liquids such as crude oil, chemicals or gas.

A {{ro-ro ship}} carries cars and trucks that roll on and roll off the ship. Passenger ships and ferries carry people. In Mexico, the ports of Altamira and Tampico receive ships from many countries every week.
On every {{voyage}}, the crew communicates with port authorities, pilots and other ships. That is why a cadet needs to know the names of ships and cargo in English.

ejercicios.enunciado: Which ship carries liquids such as crude oil?
A ___ carries loose cargo such as grain or coal.

Escucha la orden a máquinas y elige la opción correcta.

lineas.texto: Altamira Port Control, Altamira Port Control. This is Cadet Star, Cadet Star. Over.
